trace.query: What are lunch hours at Executive Dining in the Academic Building?

retrieved_chunks.title: Academic Building Dining
retrieved_chunks.text:
Campus dining — Academic Building

Three dining halls on campus serve Chinese, Western, and Halal dishes. This note covers only the two Academic Building venues.

University Dining @ Academic Building:
Breakfast 07:00-09:30
Lunch 11:00-13:30
Dinner 17:00-19:30

Executive Dining @ Academic Building:
Lunch 11:00-13:30
No breakfast hours and no dinner hours are listed for Executive Dining.

This note does not list menu prices, meal-plan costs, or dish names.

retrieved_chunks.title: Conference Center Dining
retrieved_chunks.text:
Campus dining — Conference Center Halal Dining

Halal Dining @ Conference Center:
Lunch 11:00-13:30
Dinner 17:00-19:30

No breakfast hours are listed for Halal Dining at the Conference Center.

This venue is not University Dining in the Academic Building. It does not list prices.

Source: https://commencement.dukekunshan.edu.cn/plan-your-visit/ (retrieved 2026-09-10)
